note: Evals 1-5 and 7 run in a project whose .agents/project.json is profiles/example.json (Jira project SHOP, repos shop-api and shop-web); evals 6 and 8-12 run in a repo with no profile.

evals.name: full-ticket
evals.expected_output: Announces the full depth; reads the ticket and its comments; traces the current flow in shop-web and shop-api with file:line per hop on each repo's default branch; publishes a page from assets/explain.html with its Départ (TLDR, then the trip map drawn from the stations, Avant and Après), its stations each with its layer, and its Terminus; then opens every station file in the editor (from the ticket worktree) in trip order with one message of one line per station, then asks the user to say 1 or 2 key points back (« redis-le-moi »), skippable, with no questions on the page
assertions: The explain skill is used
Reads .agents/project.json before investigating
States the chosen depth in one line before explaining
Every hop of the current flow cites a file:line
Code excerpts come from the default branch on origin, not the local checkout
Identifiers stay verbatim (no renamed or translated function, field or service names)
Each term is glossed once, at first use
Builds the page with scripts/explain-page

Page is a métro trip: Départ with the trip map (one lane per repo, links on segments that are not a direct call), one station per flow hop named after its real identifier with its own pic and its layer, and a Terminus with traps and open questions
Opens every station's file with the editor CLI from a worktree inside the workspace, in trip order, and sends one message with one line per station
No Edit or Write on a repo file
Ends with a « redis-le-moi » of 1 or 2 open prompts aimed at the delta or a blocking trap, and says « passe » skips it
The page data holds no gate questions

evals.name: light-ticket
evals.prompt: explique-moi SHOP-387, c'est juste un tooltip je pense
evals.expected_output: Announces the light depth; Départ, the stations that change and the Terminus; one « redis-le-moi » prompt
assertions: Announces the léger depth with its reason
Has no station for a hop that does not change
One « redis-le-moi » prompt, skippable

evals.name: no-editor
evals.expected_output: Explains as usual, then sends the walk as one message with one line per station, each path:line as a link, and runs no editor command
assertions: Runs no code or cursor command
The walk message has one line per station with a path:line link

evals.name: express-bump
evals.prompt: explique-moi SHOP-402 (bump d'une librairie de 4.12.0 à 4.12.1 dans shop-web, rien d'autre)
evals.expected_output: Picks express in one line with its reason; reads the ticket and the changed dependency line with its changelog; answers with a 2-3 bullet TLDR in the chat, each bullet with a file:line; no page, no walk, no subagent; then records the Compréhension section
assertions: States the express depth and why in one line
Gives a TLDR of 2 or 3 bullets with a file:line
Publishes no page
No « redis-le-moi »
Writes the ## Compréhension section from the TLDR

evals.name: initiative
evals.expected_output: Full depth; reads the initiative, its epics and their stories one level at a time; the trip is the end-to-end journey the children deliver; the page pins each child ticket on the stations it touches and shows the uncovered hops as gaps
assertions: Reads the children one level down at a time
Page data has tickets with stations, and gap children where no ticket covers a hop
Marks with links the segments that are not a direct call

evals.name: no-profile
evals.prompt: explique-moi https://github.com/acme/shop/issues/42 avant que je code
evals.expected_output: Finds no .agents/project.json; reads the issue with gh issue view --comments; takes the repos root from the current repo's parent and each repo's default branch from origin/HEAD; asks once for the domain; offers to save the profile; then explains as usual
assertions: Looks for .agents/project.json before investigating
Reads the issue and its comments with gh
Asks for missing profile fields in one message, not one by one
Offers to save .agents/project.json
Never assumes Jira or a master branch

evals.name: called-from-delivery
evals.prompt: (delivery's Understand phase on SHOP-431, Situate's repo table already given)
evals.expected_output: Skips the page: the TLDR, the traps (blocking first) and the open questions go in the chat, then the walk in the editor; the page is built only if the user asks
assertions: Publishes no page unless asked
Gives the TLDR, traps and open questions in the chat
Walks the stations in the editor

evals.name: module-no-key
evals.expected_output: Says the subject is a module and reads it on HEAD, naming the branch; asks for no ticket key and no profile; explains what the module is for, its entry points, who calls it, what it calls and its main path, each hop with a file:line; walks the files in the current checkout with no worktree; ends with a « redis-le-moi »; records the notes under a slug
assertions: Asks for no ticket key, tracker or profile
Says which branch HEAD is before explaining
Names the entry points, the callers and what the module calls, each with a file:line
Creates no worktree
The page data, when built, has kind module, source.ref HEAD and no key

evals.name: flow-on-head
evals.prompt: c'est quoi le flow quand on soumet une commande ?
evals.expected_output: Says the subject is a flow; traces the current flow end to end on HEAD with a file:line per hop; nothing is marked as changing; the page has no avant/après
assertions: Every hop cites a file:line
No station is marked as changed
The page data has kind flow and no product

evals.name: pull-request
evals.prompt: explique-moi la PR 42 avant que je la review
evals.expected_output: Reads the PR with gh pr view and gh pr diff, and the ticket it names; explains the flow before and what the diff changes at each hop; the stations that change are marked
assertions: Reads the diff with gh pr diff
Marks the stations the diff changes
The page data has kind diff

evals.name: say-it-back-gap
evals.prompt: (after the « redis-le-moi » on the fee floor) 1. le plancher s'applique dans total(), après avoir ajouté le frais
evals.expected_output: Confirms what is right in one line, corrects only the gap (the floor is applied in fee_for, before total adds it) in two or three lines with the hop's file:line, and does not repeat the whole explanation
assertions: Corrects only the point that was wrong
Cites the hop's file:line
Two or three lines, not the explanation again
At most one more prompt on the same point

evals.name: say-it-back-skip
evals.expected_output: Notes the skip in the Compréhension section and moves on with no further question
assertions: Asks nothing more
Records that the « redis-le-moi » was skipped

evals.name: known-zone-folds
evals.prompt: (the learner notes mark `hooks/pair-marker-check` solide, dated last week, no commit on it since) explique-moi ce module : hooks/
evals.expected_output: Reads the learner notes before picking the depth; checks with git log that the zone has not moved; says in one line what it skips and how to get the full explanation; folds the known stations into one line each with no gloss, and spends the explanation on what the notes do not cover
assertions: Reads the learner notes before explaining
Runs git log --since on the zone marked solide
Says in one line what is skipped and that « reprends tout » brings it back
Does not re-explain the zone marked solide

evals.name: recurring-gap-leads
evals.prompt: (the learner notes hold a recurring gap: confuses the branch diff with the working tree) explique-moi ce que le hook regarde sur un push
evals.expected_output: Leads with the point the gap is about, and aims the « redis-le-moi » at it
assertions: The explanation opens on the branch diff versus the working tree
The « redis-le-moi » prompt is on that point

evals.name: stale-zone
evals.prompt: (the learner notes mark `pricing/fees.py` solide two months ago; six commits touched it since) explique-moi pricing/fees.py
evals.expected_output: Says the zone moved since the notes (how many commits), treats it as vu, and explains it rather than folding it
assertions: Says how many commits touched the zone since the date in the notes
Explains the zone instead of folding it

evals.name: notes-after-say-it-back
evals.prompt: (after a « redis-le-moi » on hooks/: point 1 right, point 2 corrected)
evals.expected_output: Updates ~/.agents/learner/<project>.md: the zone with its level, today's date and one line of evidence, the gap under Écarts récurrents; observed facts only; says where the file is when it creates it
assertions: Writes or updates one line for the zone, with a level, a date and the evidence
Records the gap that was corrected
Writes no judgement of the person
Says where the file is the first time it is created

evals.name: user-says-known
evals.prompt: (mid-explanation of the checkout flow) le panier ça je connais
evals.expected_output: Stops explaining the cart, records it as solide with the user's word as evidence, and carries on with the rest
assertions: Stops explaining that zone
Records it as solide, with the user's word as the evidence
